Living Traditions

A Feast for the Senses: The Joy of an Afghan Wedding

Understand Afghan wedding traditions, feast culture, Attan dancing, and the hospitality that defines major family celebrations.
Evening / by invitation Year round
Explore experience →

traditional-sports

Buzkashi

Stand at the edge of a winter field as chapandazan compete in Afghanistan’s most powerful traditional sport.
Half day to full day Winter and early spring

Food & Culture Experience

Paktika Livestock Markets & Kuchi Culture

Use Paktika’s rural identity to tell the story of livestock markets, Kuchi movement, and Afghan pastoral life.
Variable Market days / seasonal

Shadows of the Wind: The Enduring World of the Kuchi Nomads

Spectacle, Sport & Sky

Symphony of the Skies: The Rooftop World of Kaftar Bazi

Experience Kabul rooftops, pigeon lofts, and the social world of kaftar bazi when private access can be arranged.
1–2 hours Spring–autumn afternoons

Spectacle, Sport & Sky

The Battle for the Skies: Gudiparan Bazi

1–2 hours Windy Fridays and holidays

The Living Clay of Istalif: Where Earth Meets Turquoise
